study.question: Does retaining the association of each compressed block with its own existing target-match/order detail contributions improve click validation AUC and quality-cost relative to global broadcast, and does it beat a support-preserving permutation with identical detail marginals?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: incumbent source (g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer, AUC 0.6685268680116033) broadcasts the SAME five global detail vectors into every occupied block before tanh. Its code computes blockwise detail contributions but discards their association with the scored base at the sum. Earlier target-match/task routing and coarse block detail helped (g0-r0009-match_detail_task 0.6630190; g0-r0013-block_task 0.6650111), but that does not establish this missing association is useful. Recent negative paths were retained: moment approximation 0.6684974, ordered pair 0.6683061 versus scrambled 0.6685098, finer events 0.6683747, adjacent grouping 0.6684629, and every softsign forward/backward cell below tanh/tanh. Those results weaken generic more-detail, finer-resolution and saturation-only explanations; they do not directly test block-content/detail alignment. Provisional mechanism: mean-preserving local detail in the existing task-conditioned block nonlinear map can encode which target-match/order contributions co-occur with which scored block content. If useful, aligned detail should beat both the fresh global-broadcast bridge and a permutation that preserves local marginals, at identical learned capacity. This is an unmeasured hypothesis. The incumbent improves click over both imported sources (0.6606469405 and 0.6601633627) but has lower auxiliary AUC than baseline; click selection does not establish joint-task dominance. All 215 supplied trajectory-index executions succeeded; predictive failures are not execution failures. No seed variation, saturation measurements or mechanism significance is claimed.

study.proposed_difference: One representation replacement, three standalone variants. Retain the already-computed per-block contributions d_j of the five global summaries (same coefficients/normalization). With M occupied blocks, form delta_j=M*d_j-sum_k d_k in FP32, masking before and after. Use local input [M*b_j, original global log-counts, original global_detail+delta_j], replacing only broadcast global_detail. The mean input equals the original global history in exact arithmetic; centering corrects floating reduction-order drift. aligned_detail uses each block own tuple; permuted_detail shifts all five channels together by floor(M/2) among sorted occupied ranks, preserving support and marginal distribution even with holes; broadcast_bridge zeros both deltas and reproduces the inherited input. M<=1 makes all cells identical at common weights. Both delta assignments and their zero-weight backward edges execute in all variants, and the same learned projection is applied once. The new auxiliary detail edge is detached with existing item-source ownership. Original global residual inputs and base are unchanged. No new capacity or learned interaction, task gate intervention, feedback source, loss, host option or inference-state change is introduced. This isolates local detail assignment; it does not attribute effects separately to the five detail families or establish auxiliary-transfer dependence under the new representation.
predictions: Predeclared primary direction: aligned_detail click AUC > broadcast_bridge and > permuted_detail on full validation under frozen protocol. An exploratory practical target is >=0.0002 over each; smaller positive gaps remain preliminary and are not significance claims.

At common nonzero weights aligned/permuted have identical marginal local details but distinct nonlinear summaries for constructed correlated base/detail examples. Their linearized-summary means and singleton/empty outputs agree within declared dtype tolerances.

No trainable parameter change: host should confirm 32192421 total, 31793216 embedding and 399205 dense parameters. All task metrics and auxiliary regressions are reported; a click gain alone does not imply multitask benefit.

A favorable efficiency result requires measured per-unit train/wall and inference p95 <=1.20 times the fresh broadcast control; otherwise report the frontier tradeoff. Projection shapes match, but extra retained block activations can increase memory and cost.

Longer-history slices may show larger effects, but are exploratory proxies for multiple occupied blocks. Training differences can propagate to singleton/empty validation predictions; common-weight identities do not imply trained-slice identity.
falsifiers: If aligned_detail does not beat broadcast_bridge, the proposed replacement has not improved the incumbent under this recipe; retain the negative result and incumbent, without claiming that all local alignment mechanisms are refuted.

If aligned_detail improves over broadcast but not over permuted_detail, block-content/detail association is unsupported; detail marginals, variance, nonlinear scale or optimization are viable explanations.

If the fresh broadcast bridge fails common-weight prediction/gradient/state parity, or any source/mask/parameter contract check fails, no performance comparison is interpretable until the authorized host corrects it. Keep failures and costs; unknown execution state does not permit duplicate runs.

A benefit confined to auxiliary mean, unaccounted capacity, disproportionate cost, or one exploratory slice does not satisfy the primary claim. Small single-seed differences after extensive adaptive selection cannot establish a mechanism or significance.
alternative_explanations: Localizing five detail channels changes their within-population variance and tanh saturation even while means match. The occupied-block permutation controls those marginals for the alignment contrast; broadcast comparison alone cannot identify association.

The deterministic shift preserves some associations and is identity for singleton support. Failure against it may reflect a weak intervention; any stronger diagnostic would need a new predeclared admissible study, not outcome-driven reinterpretation.
Auxiliary-label mismatch, inherited source-gradient isolation and single-pass optimization may dominate representation effects; this round does not vary these factors.

BF16 rounding, retained-activation memory, kernel timing, repeated same-seed training and long adaptive validation search can explain small gaps. Native parity checks, measured cost and later authorized paired-seed/user-cluster assessment are needed.

Absolute block/order information is already in the inherited coefficients. This experiment concerns their pairing with content, not proof of a general temporal reasoning mechanism or verified originality.
